properties.statement: PREVIEW appears in the headline, the plain-language summary and the shareable full report, and the full report states that no crash occurred
Every device and app metadata field is null
Reset is inert in a preview: previewing can never wipe app data
properties.evidence: NEEDS-DEVICE-VALIDATION: behaviour of the recovery screen, not of the pure report

properties.statement: Continue is inert beyond closing the screen: previewing never relaunches the app
properties.evidence: NEEDS-DEVICE-VALIDATION: behaviour of the recovery screen, not of the pure report

properties.statement: The preview report is synthesized from literals and the caller's label only, never read from disk
